references.text: Warns against taking bribes, for bribes blind the clear-sighted and twist the cause of the righteous.
Describes the righteous person who does not take a bribe against the innocent.
The wicked takes a bribe from the bosom to pervert the course of justice.
The prophet accuses the people of taking bribes to shed blood.
Prohibition against spreading false rumors or helping the wicked by being an unjust witness.
You shall not pervert justice, show partiality, or accept a bribe.
Isaiah accuses Israel's leaders of taking bribes and failing to defend the fatherless and widows.
Judas admits that he has sinned by betraying innocent blood for money.
